controls.tooltip: Clear Seam · the selected edges (all with none selected) leave the seam map

controls.tooltip: Select Seam · select the seam map's edges

controls.label: Unwrap & Relax

controls.tooltip: Move and Sew · move the island across the seam to meet it, then join · Shift: this island goes · Alt: the other comes · Ctrl: options
